title: Deploy with GitHub Pages
summary: Put a project on the web with GitHub Pages: what a static host serves, a plain page published from a branch, the base and the routing a Vite project needs, and a GitHub Actions workflow that builds and publishes on every push. You will finish with your own React project at your own address, updating every time you push.
